user.title: Connect Leapmotor
user.description: Sets up Leapmotor vehicle data. App certificate and app private key are required for login; paste or upload them here, or place them as app_cert.pem and app_key.pem in /config/leapmotor first. The vehicle PIN is optional; without it only read-only data works, not remote control. ABRP live data is optional; use your ABRP Generic token from the ABRP vehicle live-data setup. Unofficial integration: use at your own risk; no liability for account restrictions, API changes, or vehicle consequences.

certificate_source.title: Leapmotor certificates
certificate_source.description: Logging in to Leapmotor needs the app certificate and its private key (app_cert.pem and app_key.pem). They are not part of this integration. Home Assistant can download them from the community repository {repository}, or you can provide the two files yourself. Either way they are stored only on this system, in /config/leapmotor.

menu_options.certificates: Upload or paste the files myself

certificates.title: Leapmotor certificates
certificates.description: Switch on the download to fetch both files from {repository}, or upload the app certificate and private key (or paste their PEM contents). They are stored locally as /config/leapmotor/app_cert.pem and /config/leapmotor/app_key.pem and are not included in the public repository.

data_description.download_certificates: Fetches the current app_cert.pem and app_key.pem from the leapmotor-certs repository and checks that they belong together. Files you upload or paste below are used instead.

error.certificate_import_error: Certificate import failed. Check the PEM certificate and private key.
error.app_cert_invalid: The certificate file is not a valid PEM certificate. Check that app_cert.pem contains the full BEGIN/END CERTIFICATE block.
error.app_key_invalid: The private key file is not a valid PEM private key. Check that app_key.pem contains the full BEGIN/END PRIVATE KEY block and is not encrypted.
error.certificate_key_mismatch: The certificate and private key do not match. Make sure app_cert.pem and app_key.pem are the matching pair from the same source.
error.share_accept_failed: The invitation could not be accepted. Try again, or accept it in the Leapmotor app.
error.share_not_ready: The invitation was accepted, but the car has not appeared in the account yet. Submit again in a moment.
error.cert_download_cannot_connect: The certificates could not be downloaded: GitHub was not reachable from Home Assistant. Check the internet connection and submit again, or upload the two files yourself.
error.cert_download_not_found: No certificate files were found in the leapmotor-certs repository. Upload the two files yourself.
error.cert_download_invalid: The downloaded files are not a valid, matching certificate and key, so nothing was changed. Try again later, or upload the two files yourself.
error.cert_download_write_failed: The certificates were downloaded but could not be stored in /config/leapmotor. Check that the folder is writable.

set_charging_schedule.name: Set charging schedule
set_charging_schedule.description: Set the car's charging schedule in one command: time window, weekdays, charge limit, weekly repetition and auto recharge. Fields you leave out keep the value the car has now. Requires the configured vehicle PIN.

start_time.name: Start time
start_time.description: When charging may start, in the car's local time. In YAML write it in quotes, for example "23:00".

end_time.name: End time
end_time.description: When charging stops. A window over midnight is fine, for example 23:00 to 06:00.

days.name: Days
days.description: Weekdays the schedule applies to. Also accepted as numbers, 1 (Monday) to 7 (Sunday).

enabled.name: Schedule on
enabled.description: Switch the schedule on. Turn this off to store the schedule but leave it switched off.

charge_limit_percent.name: Charge limit
charge_limit_percent.description: Upper charge limit in percent (T03: 50 to 100).

repeat_weekly.name: Repeat every week
repeat_weekly.description: Repeat the schedule every week on the chosen days. Off means it runs once.
